data_policy.selection: lower-median registry size family (27:45) and smallest registry exceeding default leaf_limit64 (25:68), selected by counts before timing
data_policy.event_cycle: insert held document; disable target; reenable; text-version; replace text/vector; restore; delete first fragment; restore; delete held document; atomic fragment remove/reinsert with new version
data_policy.texts: Only existing real development source text; synthetic event histories, no new real releases claimed

headroom.purpose: conditional full-path cost headroom; not superiority and not independent family-population inference
headroom.stop_large_search_if: All three complete equal-family block floors exceed .90 and no complete block gives 10% engine-only headroom; only requested validated cleanup comparison continues. This is a conditional budget decision, not final-domain impossibility.

iterations.hypothesis: E06 H03: avoid max_norm2 for C1-family consumers; compute reusable exact query norms once for B4/B5 norm sorting and summaries. No score/certificate formula changes.
iterations.expected: lower build/partition cost, identical blocks/output/bounds and update score counts; no new algorithmic novelty
iterations.implementation: new namespace src/pvldb_a_e07_i01; preserve original package

iterations.hypothesis: Use finite binary64 widths only for KD split-axis selection; all produced boxes still enclose exact stored query coordinates. Exact Fraction widths are unnecessary for partition correctness.
iterations.expected: cheaper multi-leaf build; output invariants unchanged though partition may differ; retain exact BOX predicate
iterations.execute: Only if headroom budget decision permits more work and I01 did not supply eligible candidate

iterations.hypothesis: leaf_limit=8 may reduce geometric false rejections; pay extra boxes, routing and failed bounds; cost benefit must survive full path.
iterations.expected: more successful certificates possible but cost regression possible; test rather than assume
iterations.execute: Only if I02 is valid, headroom permits, no successful candidate and budget remains

comparison.primary_mode: cold; physical initial/delta embeddings, within-run cache shared symmetrically
comparison.additional_panel_scope: bounded feasibility diagnostic; never sufficient for final E02 gate. Full mandatory 20-block validation required only for promising selected candidate.
comparison.future_iterations: Same 20 block plan and strong B2/B3 controls; each iteration own frozen commands/code/run IDs. No stopping at favorable p-value.

validation_policy: Run complete E04 differential/property acceptance suite in fresh output path for each new code version, plus structural norm/partition audit on both selected full registries. No speed run before pass. Do not overwrite earlier reports. New code validity does not automatically update historical E04.

acceptance.cleanup: Accept engineering change only if correct, equal non-time counters/required block metadata and lower partition cost; preserve version even if no scientific success.
acceptance.candidate: Original E02 <=.90 simultaneous one-sided upper vs EVERY mandatory baseline on held-out validation; each family no regression; memory/tail constraints and novelty/ablations verified; all thresholds unchanged. Screening insufficient for pass.
acceptance.promote_to_validation: 20-block selected development aggregate upper<=.90 vs BOTH B2 and B3, no family geomean regression, correctness passes. Then freeze candidate and complete all mandatory panel and validation before any pass decision.
acceptance.failure: No candidate after budget/conditional headroom stop -> completed with gate rework or stop; no E08. Record targeted R02 and affected-version scopes.

uncertainty: Paired complete timing blocks; 10000 bootstrap; Bonferroni .05/7 for mandatory contrasts. Headroom three-block and ready five-block results descriptive; no final superiority claim from them.
memory_and_reads: New common runner records actual one-query reads with pin/materialize cost and process-tree samples; conservative operational self+child peak and sampled whole-life RSS remain distinct; no invented exact ratio certificate.
revision: Only planned run-count arithmetic corrected 354->360; schedule/rules unchanged, before any timing.
